 Print CEE Kerala NEET PG Counselling 2026: Download provisional allotment PDF, check complaint deadline and next steps Kerala NEET PG Counselling 2026 : The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala, has published the provisional allotment list for the first phase of NEET PG Counselling 2026. Candidates who registered for the state-level postgraduate medical admission process can now check their provisional seat allotment status through the official website, cee.kerala.gov.in. Candidates have been given an opportunity to report discrepancies in the provisional allotment list until 10 AM on November 2, 2026. The CEE Kerala notification states that complaints must be submitted within the prescribed deadline. The final allotment list will be published after the authorities examine and address genuine grievances, if any. Kerala NEET PG Phase 1 provisional allotment PDF The provisional allotment result is available in PDF format on the official CEE Kerala portal. Candidates can access the document through the NEET PG section of the website and check the allotment details. Direct link: Kerala NEET PG Counselling 2026 Phase 1 provisional allotment PDF 
 Candidates who identify discrepancies in their allotment details must notify the Commissioner for Entrance Examinations by email. The complaint must be sent to ceekinfo.cee@kerala.gov.in with the subject line: PG Medical- Provisional Allotment Complaints The deadline for submitting complaints is 10 AM on November 2, 2026. Complaints received within the stipulated period will be considered for verification before the final allotment is issued. Steps to download Kerala NEET PG provisional allotment list Candidates can follow these steps to access the Phase 1 provisional allotment result: Step 1: Visit the official CEE Kerala website at cee.kerala.gov.in. Step 2: Open the NEET PG section on the homepage. Step 3: Click on the Allotment List option. Step 4: Select the Phase 1 Provisional Allotment List link. Step 5: The provisional allotment PDF will appear on the screen. Step 6: Download the PDF and retain a copy for future reference. Candidates should check the allotment list carefully and report any discrepancies within the notified grievance window. Kerala NEET PG Counselling 2026 final allotment result CEE Kerala will publish the first phase final allotment result after reviewing the complaints received against the provisional list. The final allotment will reflect any changes made following the examination of genuine grievances. Candidates allotted seats in the final result will have to complete the admission process by reporting to their respective colleges. They must carry the original certificates and relevant documents, along with photocopies, for verification and admission formalities. The final allotment result and subsequent admission-related instructions will be made available through the official CEE Kerala website.
